trade_note: DuctLink is software for HVAC sheet-metal fabrication shops. Buyers are shop owners; their customers are HVAC techs ordering fittings from a phone. HVAC preset applies; 3D is allowed because there is a real product to show (DuctLink's own parametric fittings).

palette.source: Logo (v1/public/favicon.svg): graphite #1b2430 ground, amber #f2a33a stroke. App accent (v1/src/styles.css): #d9751a.

accent.use: buttons, airflow line, focus rings; never body text on light

accent-text.use: links and accent text on light surfaces

accent-on-dark.use: logo amber; accent text and airflow line on dark

type.heading: Manrope
type.note: Approved list, HVAC preset. Dimensions in the product UI stay in the body face with tabular numerals.

motion.description: The hero shows a real DuctLink fitting (rendered from the app's own geometry) slowly turning, with its dimension lines drawn in. From the fitting's outlet a single 2px amber line runs down the page as the visitor scrolls, branching once at each step of 'How it works' (tech's phone -> shop inbox -> ready for pickup) and ending at the sign-up button.

implementation.hero: React Three Fiber + Drei, dynamically imported with ssr:false. One fitting, no environment map, flat material.
implementation.path: Inline SVG path, stroke-dashoffset scrubbed by GSAP ScrollTrigger. Lenis smooth scroll in the root layout.
implementation.duration_rules: No element animates for more than 600ms outside scroll scrub. No parallax on text.

fallbacks.below_768px: Static hero image (public/hero-static.webp, a render of the same fitting). Airflow line is drawn fully, no scrub.
fallbacks.prefers_reduced_motion: Same as mobile: static image, line fully drawn, Lenis off.

motion.budget: Under 300 KB JS on /, under 1.5 MB first load excluding images.

copy_voice.tone: Plain, direct, shop-floor. Written for the owner of a fab shop who takes orders by phone, text, and scribbled sketches today.
do: Name the real parts: elbows, transitions, offsets, filter boxes, collars, plenums.
Name the real pain: misread sketches, missing dimensions, orders lost in texts.
Say what the product does, step by step.
dont: No invented customer counts, testimonials, time-saved percentages, or logos.
No pricing numbers until the owner sets them.

hero_image.source: Own render of DuctLink's parametric fitting geometry (v1/src/shapes). No third-party models or stock photography.

open_questions: Production domain (assumed ductlink.com for marketing, app.ductlink.com for the app).
Any real shop willing to be quoted? Until then the page has no testimonials.
Instructional videos to record (catalog drafted in src/content/videos.ts).
